LanguageData.CaravanCarriers_Intro: A carrier carries one caravan member the way a rideable animal does, and is not counted as a rider itself. Changes apply straight away.
LanguageData.CaravanCarriers_StatRule: Any adult whose caravan riding speed is above 100% is a carrier and uses that value. Genes or a race can raise it.
LanguageData.CaravanCarriers_SizeRuleTip: Lets large pawns carry without a caravan riding speed of their own.
LanguageData.CaravanCarriers_SizeFactor: Caravan speed for the member carried: {0}
LanguageData.CaravanCarriers_SizeFactorNote: For comparison, vanilla horses give 160% and most other rideable animals 130%. A carrier with a higher caravan riding speed of its own keeps that instead.
LanguageData.CaravanCarriers_CarrierTip: Can carry one caravan member, the way a rideable animal does.\n\nCaravan speed for the member carried: {0}
